cases.sentence: Ты сдержал обещание ___ Давиду, моему отцу.
cases.explain: «Твоему слуге» — the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: who have kept with your servant David my father that which you promised him. Yes, you spoke with your mouth, and have fulfilled it with your hand, as it is today.

cases.sentence: Суди между ___ и воздай виновному, обрушив на его же голову то, что он сделал, и оправдай невиновного, утвердив его правоту.
cases.explain: «Твоими слугами» — after the preposition «между», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: “If a man sins against his neighbor, and an oath is laid on him to cause him to swear, and he comes and swears before your altar in this house;

cases.sentence: Научи их ___, чтобы им ходить по нему и пошли дождь на землю, которую Ты дал в наследие Твоему народу.
cases.explain: «доброму пути» — the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: “When the sky is shut up, and there is no rain, because they have sinned against you; if they pray toward this place, and confess your name, and turn from their sin, when you afflict them;
